outcome: Composite obstetric and perinatal adverse outcome
cohort: Pregnant women with autoimmune disorders and/or autoimmune antibody positivity who were screened for complement levels prior to their pregnancies were enrolled in a special antenatal care program.
finding: Despite immunomodulatory treatment, current obstetric and neonatal outcomes showed no significant difference between hypocomplement and normocomplement patients, although the Beksac Obstetric Index (reflecting past obstetric history) was significantly lower in hypocomplement patients.
